_comment: Human decisions for gen_licenses.py (NATIVE-DESKTOP-PLAN.md 26.9). Everything here needs a reason and a basis; the generator refuses an entry without them. It classifies licences mechanically and stops at anything it cannot classify: add a `reviewed` entry ONLY after a person has read the package's licence.

mkl.reason: Intel Simplified Software License: redistributable in binary form with its notice; the notice text is the package's own info/licenses file, shipped in licenses/texts/

gmsh.reason: GPL-2.0-or-later; allowed only in the separate optional add-on runtime, never in the base installer

tetgen.reason: wraps TetGen, AGPL-3.0; allowed only in the separate optional add-on runtime, never in the base installer

embedded.reason: header-only MIT code compiled into tcad_desktop.exe (no DLL), so it is listed explicitly (section 7.3 table)
